notes: Fixed recording a transfer when you had already paid part of the balance down yourself. Entering an amount smaller than the closed total quietly did nothing, so your progress stayed overstated. The amount you enter is now used exactly, and the screen shows the split as you type - what moved, and what still counts as paid by you.
Fixed the 'debt eliminated' celebration firing when you recorded a transfer. Moving a balance to another card is not a debt beaten, so it no longer triggers a celebration or a win card.
